notes.title: Unline Status & Info
notes.content:
[h2]The development of Unline is on hiatus.[/h2]
I need to have a clear idea of what Unline is and how I can turn it into the story I have always wanted to share, one that satisfies me and you.

[h3]But I will share my current idea of what Unline is and what you can expect in the future.[/h3]
Unline is a story of sadness, repentance and recovery.
A story that is part of a joyful world that hides something darker.
The ethereal mingling with the more physical part of the world itself.
Continuous contrasts that cannot exist without the other, the dependence of both.

I feel sorry for those who have waited so long but...
Stay tuned, [b]Unline will be back[/b].
